name: Interval Intersection Obfuscation
description: Replaces the algebraic global sum constraint with an equivalent geometric local constraint. Monomers are assigned intervals [0,1] or [1,2], and bonds require these intervals to intersect at exactly one point. This perfectly encodes the bipartite inequality constraint (x != y) while sounding like an interval scheduling or sweep-line problem, misleading models into applying geometric or greedy heuristics instead of BFS.
